title: Comfortably · adv
subtitle: 「輕鬆地／舒適地／自在地／安穩地」，究竟是哪一種 comfortably？
description: 「輕鬆地／舒適地／自在地／安穩地」，究竟是哪一種 comfortably？

words.note: 當 comfortably 表示做某事不費力、順利完成時最直接；重點是容易程度，而不是身體舒適。
words.example: She completed the climb with ease.

exercises.original: She completed the difficult route comfortably despite the steep final section.
exercises.zh: 儘管最後一段很陡，她仍輕鬆完成了困難路線。
exercises.upgrade: with ease · 輕鬆地；毫不費力地

options.explanation: quickly = quickly 只表示速度；句子強調的是 steep route 對她並不費力。
safely = safely 表示沒有危險，不能表達完成得毫不費力。
with ease = despite the steep final section 顯示她完成時沒有明顯困難，因此 with ease 最精確。
carelessly = carelessly 表示粗心，和成功完成困難路線不符。
painfully = painfully 表示痛苦，和 comfortably 的意思相反。
securely = securely 適合固定或安全位置，不適合描述完成路線的難易度。

exercises.original: He answered all ten questions comfortably.
exercises.zh: 他輕鬆回答了全部十條問題。
exercises.upgrade: with ease · 輕鬆地；毫不費力地

options.explanation: at ease = at ease 描述心理自在，不直接修飾答題難易度。
quickly = 可能答得快，但原句沒有速度線索。
securely = 不合回答問題。
with ease = 十條問題都能不費力完成，with ease 很自然。
snugly = 只適合貼合、暖和的物理語境。
safely = 回答問題沒有安全性重點。

exercises.original: The experienced driver handled the narrow road comfortably.
exercises.zh: 有經驗的司機輕鬆應付狹窄道路。
exercises.upgrade: with ease · 輕鬆地；毫不費力地

options.explanation: carelessly = experienced driver 並非粗心駕駛。
quickly = 狹窄道路上快駕反而不一定合適。
relaxedly = 可描述姿態，但 handle ... with ease 更直接表示駕駛技巧。
painfully = 意思相反。
with ease = experienced driver + difficult road 顯示能力足夠，最自然是 with ease。
roomily = 只描述空間寬敞。

words.note: 最直接的描述性替換之一，表示身體或姿勢沒有疼痛、壓迫、疲勞等不舒服感。
words.example: He can sit for an hour without discomfort.
words.exampleZh: 他可以坐一小時而不感到不適。

exercises.original: She can wear the shoes comfortably for several hours.
exercises.zh: 她可以穿這雙鞋數小時而不感到不適。
exercises.upgrade: without discomfort · 沒有不適地；舒適地

options.explanation: easily = easily 只表示容易，不自然描述鞋子是否磨腳。
quickly = 時間長短和速度無關。
securely = 鞋可以穿得穩，但原句重點是身體舒適。
without discomfort = 鞋子是否令腳不舒服，是 without discomfort 的典型語境。
at ease = 較偏心理自在。
carelessly = 不合。

exercises.original: He slept comfortably despite the unfamiliar bed.
exercises.zh: 雖然床很陌生，他仍睡得沒有不適。
exercises.upgrade: without discomfort · 沒有不適地；舒適地

options.explanation: quickly = 入睡快不等於睡得舒服。
safely = 睡眠安全與身體舒適不同。
with ease = 可形容入睡容易，但這裡重點是 bed 沒造成不適。
securely = 可表示安穩，但未必沒有身體不適。
without discomfort = unfamiliar bed 使身體舒適成為核心，因此 without discomfort 最精確。
carelessly = 不合睡眠。

exercises.original: The patient could move her arm comfortably after treatment.
exercises.zh: 治療後，病人活動手臂時沒有不適。
exercises.upgrade: without discomfort · 沒有不適地；舒適地

options.explanation: easily = 可能動作容易，但醫療語境重點是沒有疼痛或不適。
quickly = 速度不是核心。
relaxedly = 不自然形容手臂活動的症狀。
safely = 安全與疼痛程度不同。
roomily = 完全不合。
without discomfort = 醫療治療後描述活動時沒有痛楚或不適，應用 without discomfort。

words.note: 當 comfortably 指某任務、距離、數量或要求可以毫不勉強地做到時很自然；比 with ease 更簡潔。
words.example: The car can easily carry five adults.
words.exampleZh: 這輛車可以輕鬆載五名成人。

exercises.original: The suitcase fits comfortably in the overhead compartment.
exercises.zh: 這個行李箱可以輕鬆放進上方行李艙。
exercises.upgrade: easily · 容易地；輕鬆地

options.explanation: snugly = snugly 表示緊密貼合；原句更像空間足夠。
at ease = 只用於人或心理狀態。
securely = 表示穩固，但不等於尺寸綽綽有餘。
relaxedly = 不合無生命物件。
easily = 尺寸和空間足夠、放入毫不費力，easily 最自然。
without discomfort = 行李箱不會感到身體不適。

exercises.original: The hall can comfortably seat three hundred people.
exercises.zh: 這個禮堂可以輕鬆容納三百人就座。
exercises.upgrade: easily · 容易地；輕鬆地

options.explanation: securely = 座位安全不是容量重點。
snugly = 會暗示過於擠迫。
at ease = 不能修飾 hall capacity。
quickly = 容納人數和速度無關。
carelessly = 完全不合。
easily = 這裡的 comfortably 表示容量有餘裕，因此 easily 很自然。

exercises.original: She can comfortably finish the assignment before Friday.
exercises.zh: 她可以輕鬆在星期五前完成作業。
exercises.upgrade: easily · 容易地；輕鬆地

options.explanation: easily = 時間和能力都有餘裕，easily 比 physical-comfort 詞更精確。
in comfort = 較適合身體舒適，不自然表示時間餘裕。
at ease = 是心理狀態。
snugly = 不合。
securely = 不合完成作業。
painfully = 意思相反。

words.note: 當 comfortably 指一個人在社交、陌生環境或心理上感到自在、不緊張時最精確。
words.example: She quickly felt at ease with her new colleagues.
words.exampleZh: 她很快就在新同事面前感到自在。

exercises.original: She felt comfortable with the new team after only a few days.
exercises.zh: 幾天後，她就在新團隊中感到自在。
exercises.upgrade: at ease · 自在地；放鬆地

options.explanation: with ease = 表示做事不費力，不能自然接 felt 表示心理狀態。
snugly = 形容貼合或暖和，不是社交心理狀態。
securely = 可表示安全感，但不如 at ease 自然表達不緊張。
quickly = 只表示時間速度。
carelessly = 不合。
at ease = 和新同事相處時不緊張、感到自在，at ease 最精確。

exercises.original: The interviewer tried to make the candidate feel comfortably.
exercises.zh: 面試官嘗試令應徵者感到自在。
exercises.upgrade: at ease · 自在地；放鬆地

options.explanation: at ease = make someone feel at ease 是固定而自然的表達。
easily = feel easily 不自然。
in comfort = 偏身體舒適，不如社交心理語境。
securely = 可表示安全，但面試重點是減少緊張。
roomily = 只形容空間。
painfully = 意思相反。

exercises.original: He spoke comfortably with people he had never met before.
exercises.zh: 他和從未見過的人交談時仍很自在。
exercises.upgrade: at ease · 自在地；放鬆地

options.explanation: with ease = 可表示說話很容易，但缺少陌生社交中的心理自在。
at ease = 陌生社交場合仍不緊張，核心是心理 at ease。
securely = 不自然修飾 speaking。
snugly = 不合。
quickly = 不表示心理狀態。
carelessly = 不合。

words.note: 當 comfortably 強調旅行、居住、坐臥或使用某空間時的實際舒適程度，可用這個較正式的說法。
words.example: The passengers travelled in comfort throughout the journey.
words.exampleZh: 乘客整段旅程都很舒適。

exercises.original: The passengers travelled comfortably in the newly upgraded seats.
exercises.zh: 乘客坐在新升級座椅上舒適地旅行。
exercises.upgrade: in comfort · 舒適地；安逸地

options.explanation: in comfort = 升級座椅帶來實際身體舒適，in comfort 最自然。
with ease = 旅行並不是任務難易度問題。
easily = 不自然描述座椅帶來的身體舒適。
securely = 可表示安全，但 upgraded seats 重點是舒適。
quickly = 未提速度。
carelessly = 不合。

exercises.original: The family lived comfortably in the larger apartment.
exercises.zh: 這家人在較大的公寓中住得很舒適。
exercises.upgrade: in comfort · 舒適地；安逸地

options.explanation: easily = 不自然描述居住舒適。
in comfort = 住宅空間改善帶來舒適生活條件，in comfort 很自然。
at ease = 偏心理自在，不如居住條件具體。
securely = 只表示安全。
roomily = 可表示空間寬敞，但整體 living conditions 更適合 in comfort。
quickly = 不合。

exercises.original: Guests can wait comfortably in the lounge.
exercises.zh: 賓客可以在休息室舒適地等候。
exercises.upgrade: in comfort · 舒適地；安逸地

options.explanation: with ease = 等待不是能力任務。
snugly = 會帶緊密／暖和意味。
in comfort = lounge 提供身體和環境上的舒適，最適合 in comfort。
securely = 未有安全重點。
quickly = 和等待語義無關。
carelessly = 不合。

words.note: 較少見，但可用於姿勢、坐姿或態度，表示身體或動作處於放鬆狀態；自然度通常低於 in a relaxed way。
words.example: He sat relaxedly by the window.

exercises.original: He sat comfortably with one arm resting on the back of the chair.
exercises.zh: 他放鬆地坐着，一隻手臂搭在椅背上。
exercises.upgrade: relaxedly · 放鬆地；從容地

options.explanation: easily = sit easily 不自然表達姿勢放鬆。
relaxedly = one arm resting on the chair 顯示姿勢放鬆，因此 relaxedly 可用。
securely = 表示穩固，但沒有 relaxed posture 的意味。
roomily = 只表示空間寬敞。
quickly = 和坐姿無關。
painfully = 和舒適姿勢相反。

exercises.original: She waited comfortably on the sofa, reading a magazine.
exercises.zh: 她在梳化上放鬆地等候，一邊看雜誌。
exercises.upgrade: relaxedly · 放鬆地；從容地

options.explanation: quickly = 等待沒有速度優勢。
carelessly = 不等於放鬆。
relaxedly = sofa + magazine 直接營造放鬆姿態，relaxedly 合適。
securely = 未有安全／固定重點。
with ease = 不適合描述等待姿態。
painfully = 和 sofa/magazine 情境相反。

exercises.original: He leaned back comfortably during the conversation.
exercises.zh: 交談期間，他放鬆地向後靠。
exercises.upgrade: relaxedly · 放鬆地；從容地

options.explanation: easily = 不表示身體放鬆。
securely = 不是固定或安全問題。
quickly = 不合。
relaxedly = leaned back 本身就是 relaxed posture 的強烈線索。
roomily = 不合姿勢。
carelessly = 不合。

words.note: 當 comfortably 指姿勢、說話、互動或動作不緊張、不拘束時很自然。
words.example: She spoke in a relaxed way during the interview.
words.exampleZh: 她在面試中以放鬆的方式說話。

exercises.original: She spoke comfortably during the informal interview.
exercises.zh: 她在非正式面試中以放鬆的方式說話。
exercises.upgrade: in a relaxed way · 以放鬆的方式；輕鬆地

options.explanation: quickly = 說得快不等於放鬆。
carelessly = 放鬆說話不等於粗心。
in a relaxed way = informal interview 表示低壓、放鬆的說話方式，這個說法最自然。
securely = 不自然修飾 speaking。
painfully = 不合。
roomily = 只適合空間。

exercises.original: They chatted comfortably over coffee.
exercises.zh: 他們喝咖啡時輕鬆地聊天。
exercises.upgrade: in a relaxed way · 以放鬆的方式；輕鬆地

options.explanation: with ease = 會偏向談話很容易，而不是整體輕鬆氣氛。
securely = 不合。
quickly = 未表示速度。
in a relaxed way = coffee chat 強調 relaxed manner，in a relaxed way 最直接。
painfully = 相反。
snugly = 不修飾聊天方式。

exercises.original: He answered comfortably once the conversation became less formal.
exercises.zh: 當談話變得沒那麼正式後，他以更放鬆的方式回答。
exercises.upgrade: in a relaxed way · 以放鬆的方式；輕鬆地

options.explanation: easily = 可能回答容易，但 less formal 明確指 manner。
securely = 不合。
quickly = 未有速度線索。
carelessly = 非正式不等於粗心。
in a relaxed way = less formal 明確支持放鬆、不拘束的答話方式。
painfully = 相反。

words.note: 當 comfortably 指衣物、毯子、座椅或物件貼合而令人感到安全、暖和時適用；不是一般『容易做到』的意思。
words.example: The child slept snugly under the blanket.
words.exampleZh: 孩子在毯子下暖和舒適地睡着。

exercises.original: The baby slept comfortably under the warm blanket.
exercises.zh: 嬰兒在暖和的毯子下舒適地睡着。
exercises.upgrade: snugly · 舒適貼合地；暖和地

options.explanation: easily = 不表示暖和貼合感。
securely = 可表示安全，但 blanket 的溫暖包裹感更符合 snugly。
roomily = 和包裹貼合感相反。
snugly = warm blanket + sleeping 表示暖和、被包裹的舒適感，snugly 最精確。
quickly = 不合。
carelessly = 不合。

exercises.original: The scarf fits comfortably around her neck.
exercises.zh: 圍巾舒適貼合地圍在她頸上。
exercises.upgrade: snugly · 舒適貼合地；暖和地

options.explanation: roomily = 會表示過鬆，和貼合相反。
easily = 只能表示穿戴容易，不表示合身程度。
at ease = 只形容人心理自在。
quickly = 不合。
snugly = fits ... around her neck 是 snugly 的典型搭配。
securely = 可表示固定，但不如 snugly 帶舒適貼合感。

exercises.original: The child was tucked comfortably into the sleeping bag.
exercises.zh: 孩子舒適暖和地被包在睡袋裡。
exercises.upgrade: snugly · 舒適貼合地；暖和地

options.explanation: roomily = 睡袋語境更重視包裹感，不是寬敞。
with ease = 不合被包裹狀態。
quickly = 不合。
carelessly = 不合。
securely only = 雖可穩妥，但缺少暖和舒適感。
snugly = tucked into the sleeping bag 直接支持 snugly。

words.note: 較少見，當 comfortably 指空間足夠、不擁擠地容納人或物時可用；常見於 vehicle/interior 描述。
words.example: Four adults can sit roomily in the back.
words.exampleZh: 四名成人可以寬敞舒適地坐在後座。

exercises.original: The rear seats can comfortably accommodate three adults.
exercises.zh: 後座可以寬敞舒適地容納三名成人。
exercises.upgrade: roomily · 寬敞舒適地

options.explanation: snugly = snugly 會暗示三人坐得較緊。
securely = 只是坐得穩妥，不表示空間寬裕。
quickly = 與容量無關。
at ease = 只形容人的心理狀態。
roomily = 後座空間足夠、三人不擠迫，roomily 可精確表達空間餘裕。
carelessly = 不合。

exercises.original: The tent sleeps four people comfortably.
exercises.zh: 這個帳篷可以讓四人寬敞舒適地睡。
exercises.upgrade: roomily · 寬敞舒適地

options.explanation: snugly = 會暗示較貼近、空間偏緊。
with ease = 可表容量餘裕，但不如 roomily 直接表示空間。
securely = 安全固定不是容量問題。
quickly = 不合。
painfully = 相反。
roomily = 帳篷是否能讓四人不擠迫，是典型 roominess 語境。

exercises.original: Two large suitcases fit comfortably in the boot.
exercises.zh: 兩個大型行李箱可以寬鬆地放進車尾箱。
exercises.upgrade: roomily · 寬敞舒適地

options.explanation: roomily = 若重點是空間仍然寬裕，roomily 是最貼近的情境化替換。
snugly = 會表示剛好緊密放入，和 comfortably 的餘裕感不同。
securely = 不等於有充足空間。
at ease = 不能形容行李箱。
quickly = 不合。
carelessly = 不合。

words.note: 在部分語境中，comfortably 若同時含有穩定、安全、不易滑動或不易掉落的意思，可用 securely；需有明確安全或固定線索。
words.example: The baby was seated securely in the carrier.
words.exampleZh: 嬰兒安穩地坐在背帶中。

exercises.original: The child sat comfortably in the safety seat during the journey.
exercises.zh: 旅程期間，孩子安穩地坐在安全座椅中。
exercises.upgrade: securely · 安穩地；穩妥地

options.explanation: with ease = 不是完成任務難易度。
roomily = 安全座椅可能貼合，不一定寬敞。
quickly = 不合。
carelessly = 和 safety seat 的用途相反。
painfully = 相反。
securely = safety seat 令 comfortably 帶有安穩固定的意味，因此 securely 可用。

exercises.original: The backpack rested comfortably against his back.
exercises.zh: 背包安穩地貼在他的背上。
exercises.upgrade: securely · 安穩地；穩妥地

options.explanation: securely = 如果重點是背包位置穩定、不易滑動，securely 最自然。
roomily = 不合貼在背上的固定關係。
at ease = 只用於人。
quickly = 不合。
carelessly = 不合。
with ease = 不表示固定狀態。

exercises.original: The equipment was positioned comfortably inside the padded case.
exercises.zh: 設備安穩地放在有襯墊的箱內。
exercises.upgrade: securely · 安穩地；穩妥地

options.explanation: snugly = 若強調緊密貼合也可，但 padded case 語境更重視保護固定。
securely = padded case 的功能是保護和固定，因此 securely 比一般 comfortably 更精確。
easily = 放入容易不等於位置穩定。
quickly = 不合。
at ease = 不能形容 equipment。
relaxedly = 不能自然形容設備。

falseSynonyms.zh: 快速不等於舒適／輕鬆 quickly 只描述速度；comfortably 可以很慢但仍然毫不費力或沒有不適。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Quickly describes speed; comfortably describes ease, comfort, or lack of strain.

falseSynonyms.zh: 隨便粗心不等於 comfortably carelessly 表示缺乏注意、容易出錯；comfortably 不帶粗心意味。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Doing something comfortably does not mean doing it carelessly.

falseSynonyms.zh: 痛苦地和 comfortably 相反 painfully 表示有疼痛或不適；如果某人做事 comfortably，通常正是沒有這種不舒服感。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Painfully indicates discomfort; comfortably indicates the opposite.

falseSynonyms.zh: 安全地不一定等於 comfortably safely 強調沒有危險；一件事可以很安全但仍然不舒服。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Safe does not necessarily mean comfortable.

falseSynonyms.zh: easily 只涵蓋部分 comfortably easily 很適合『毫不費力』的語境，但若是座椅、衣服或身體感受，通常要用 comfortably / without discomfort。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Easily refers to effort; comfortably can also refer to physical comfort.

falseSynonyms.zh: relaxedly 不適合所有語境 relaxedly 可描述姿勢或態度放鬆，但不能自然表示容量、距離或尺寸『綽綽有餘』。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Relaxedly describes manner; comfortably can also describe capacity or margin.

falseSynonyms.zh: 形容詞與副詞不同 comfortable 是形容詞；comfortably 是副詞，修飾動作或狀態。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The chair is comfortable. She sat comfortably.

falseSynonyms.zh: 程度不同 comfortably enough 表示『足夠舒適／足夠從容』；單獨 comfortably 沒有特別強調最低足夠程度。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Comfortably enough adds the idea of sufficient comfort or margin.
